Complete ProviderConfigService behavior/API contract

Implement the entire exported interfaces and class in config-service.ts. Dependency bodies are unavailable and unallocated. Import values/types through ./config/index.js, resolveOwnedOrder from ./owned-order.js, ModelSelection type from @knorvia/shared/model-selection and ProviderSource/ProviderConfigSnapshot types from ./sources.js. Dependency public declarations accompany this document. Do not change account/auth/access/key policy; the existing guards below must be preserved as fixed compatibility obligations, with no credential reading/logging/redaction/normalization added. No real repository/source may be used.

The class stores only provided builtin source and personal repository, listener Set, subscription disposers and disposed state. Constructor registers builtin first then personal; callback reasons are knorviaBuiltin:${reason} and personal:${reason}, including empty reason suffix. Subscription failures propagate unchanged with no rollback. Notifications synchronously visit the live Set; listener throws stop traversal and propagate. When disposed, source notifications do nothing. Falsy emitted reason would use changed. onDidChange rejects disposed synchronously, adds to Set, returns function deleting that listener (runtime delete result may be boolean). dispose first commits disposed=true, calls disposers in registration order after removing all from list, then clears listeners; idempotent, native disposer throws propagate without rollback, so a throw can leave listeners uncleared but emissions remain suppressed. No source disposal/read/writes on dispose.

read is async; rejects disposed before reads, starts builtin.read then personal.read in Promise.all evaluation order, propagates exact source failures, and returns a shallow frozen object with exact keys revision=JSON.stringify([builtin.revision,personal.revision]), knorviaBuiltinRevision,personalRevision,knorviaBuiltinProviders=builtin.providers,knorviaBuiltinProviderTemplates=builtin.providerTemplates??ProviderTemplateMap.empty(),personalProviders,knorviaBuiltinModelRules=builtin.models,personalModels,personalProviderOrder=personal.providerOrder??[]. All supplied references are preserved; no source/defaultSelection fields copied, no cache. No post-await disposed check: an in-flight successful read can finish after dispose.

All ordinary personal mutations use exactly one repository.update transform; check disposed immediately before invoking update, not before builtin reads. Inside the transform the generated update starts with defaultModelSelection=current.defaultModelSelection and then operation fields, preserving defaults including an own undefined property. There is no service queue, retry, separate write or service-owned revision. Port rejection/transform/dependency/getter/callback failures retain identity and no rollback beyond repository policy. Membership validation, when present, occurs inside the transform: call assertCurrent FIRST, then compare membership.providerId to operation id and membership.personalRevision to current.revision; mismatch Error("Provider Settings membership revision conflict"). The Host-supplied membership remains trusted internal fact and must not be accepted from external renderer by new APIs. Explicit inheritedModelIds=[] replaces static ids; never union it with builtin.

replacePersonalConfig is nonasync: check disposed, return the exact repository.update Promise whose transform returns the supplied update by identity; no defaultSelection preservation here (missing means clear), no builtin read, no extra validation.

ID validation difference matters: save overlay/delete provider/reorder models only reject value.trim() empty but KEEP original raw providerId. add/rename/delete model/set enabled/draft trim providerId and modelId and reject empty. Errors: `${label} 不能为空`, label providerId or modelId. Synchronous APIs only: constructor/onDidChange/replacePersonalConfig/deletePersonalProvider/dispose. read and all other mutations are async. deletePersonalProvider validates raw nonempty id first, then checks disposed via update; removes provider, all exact provider model rules, filters current providerOrder optionally, retains defaults. No existence/builtin/account/membership restriction is added.

savePersonalProviderOverlay: validate raw id -> await builtin.read -> update. In transform membership first. Read builtin provider, current personal and current effective map=builtin.providers.overlay(current.providers). In this order reject: builtin access.type=zhipu-account && metadata.enabled===false with `Account Provider 不允许禁用: ${providerId}`; same builtin access type && supplied config.access !==undefined (null counts) with `固定 Account Provider 的 Access 只能由 Knorvia Studio Built-in Config 声明: ${providerId}`; neither current personal nor builtin with `Personal Provider 尚未创建: ${providerId}`. For builtin, a supplied config.group !=null differing from builtin.group rejects `Personal Overlay 不能改写 Built-in Provider group: ${providerId}` then drop group via withoutGroup. Otherwise group=config.group??currentPersonal?.group must be standard-personal, error `Personal-only Provider 必须使用 standard-personal group: ${providerId}`, overlay that group value onto supplied config.
Provider saving cannot mutate model membership. Existing personal's membership is normalized using membership.inheritedModelIds when present, else builtin provider or current template config builtinModelIds. Unique inherited IDs first; personal unique IDs remove inherited; withPersonalModelIds gets that result. Only when existing modelOrder is neither null nor undefined normalize its order via resolveOwnedOrder. Copy this existing normalized membership with suppliedConfig.withModelMembershipFrom; if no currentPersonal, membership becomes undefined. Build a rule by spreading current rule then providerId; apply only metadata fields !==undefined; providerName is trimmed or null, null remains null; set config last. Compare current and next effective labels (trim+toLocaleLowerCase). If next label empty or unchanged ignoring case, allow historical duplicates; otherwise any other provider matching next key rejects `Provider 名称已存在: ${nextTrimmedLabel}`. Return next providers, same models/providerOrder. No templates/default copied except ordinary update's default.

createPersonalProvider(input={}): await builtin.read BEFORE disposal check and any validation. Trim optional templateId; empty means no template. Nonempty missing template rejects `Provider Template 不存在: ${templateId}`. Then supplied initialConfig.group !==undefined rejects `initialConfig 不能包含 group`; builtinModelIds !==undefined rejects `initialConfig 不能包含 builtinModelIds` (null is also disallowed). In one update choose unoccupied id over builtin+personal keys: template seed trims, toLocaleLowerCase, replace each run not [a-z0-9] with '-', trim edge '-', fallback new-provider; no template uses new-provider. Try base then -2,-3,... . Provider label seed=input.providerName??(template ? resolveProviderTemplateName(templateId,template,input.locale??"en-US") : "new-provider"), trims/fallback new-provider; uniqueness case-insensitive against effective existing providers; those apply each current template config.overlay(personal config) then builtin overlay personal. Try label then label+' 2',' 3',... . Create rule providerId, templateId only if truthy, providerName=label. Config is new ProviderConfig({group:"standard-personal",access:templateId?undefined:new ApiKeyAccessConfig(),personalModelIds:[],modelOrder:[]}).overlay(input.initialConfig??new ProviderConfig()). Preserve models/defaults. Normalize current provider order over only current configs group standard-personal, ignore builtin IDs; remove new id then append it and renormalize. Save created id in transform. After update resolves, missing id errors `Personal Provider 创建失败` (repository could omit transform), otherwise return shallow frozen {providerId}. No full map template materialization or auth/key storage.

Provider ordering: await builtin.read even though ordering is only standard-personal current providers; resolveOwnedOrder([], standardPersonalIds, requested) and spread to mutable array. Members follow map entries order; duplicates/unrecognized requested removed by external order helper; do not reorder maps. Other fields unchanged. Model ordering helper returns mutable spread of resolveOwnedOrder(inheritedIds,personalIds,requested); dependency algorithm preserves unrequested builtin before requested and unrequested personal after requested. A writable provider for model reorder/add is current personal by identity if exists; otherwise an existing builtin permits new ProviderConfig({}); missing/deleted personal-only rejects `Provider 不存在: ${providerId}`. A current template is a model baseline when no exact builtin provider; no resurrecting deleted template instances.

reorderPersonalModels(rawid,modelIds,membership): nonempty raw id, await builtin.read, transform membership; builtin baseline exact provider??current rule's builtin providerTemplates config. Writable provider as above. withModelOrder(normalize inherited membership??baseline.builtinModelIds??[], provider.personalModelIds??[], modelIds)); set on personal map, same models/order/default.

addPersonalModel: trim provider/model then await builtin.read; transform membership, writable provider, inherited IDs membership??exactBuiltin.builtinModelIds??currentTemplate.config.builtinModelIds??[]. Reject inherited model then already personal model with `Model 已存在: ${providerId}/${modelId}`. Append to personal IDs; preserve existing requested modelOrder (or[]) and normalize over inherited and appended members. Set provider once. Exact model rule is supplied config.overlay(new ModelConfig({enabled:true})), with optional useRecommendedConfig passed unchanged to setExact; dependent validator may throw. Same providerOrder/defaults.

renamePersonalModel: trim ids; if currentId===nextId return personalRepository.read immediately without builtin read, disposed check, update, membership or existence validation (async wrapper Promise allowed). Else await builtin.read, transform membership first. Inherited IDs fallback above. Reject inherited current `Built-in Model 不能重命名: ${providerId}/${currentId}`; then absent personal membership `Personal Model 不存在: ${providerId}/${currentId}`; then personal next collision followed inherited next collision, both `Model 已存在: ${providerId}/${nextId}`. Rename member list and existing modelOrder occurrences then normalize; set provider and models.renameExactModel; preserve other fields.

setPersonalModelEnabled: trim ids, reject nonboolean `Model enabled 必须是 boolean` before builtin.read; read builtin; transform membership then existence in inherited or current personal member, else `Model 不存在: ${providerId}/${modelId}`. Current exact config??new ModelConfig({}), overlay only new ModelConfig({enabled}), setExact without recommendation flag (dependency preserves prior mode). Same provider map and providerOrder/defaults. No full draft completeness gate or mode/membership mutation.

savePersonalModelDraft: trim ids -> await builtin.read -> transform membership first -> require exact current.revision===expectedPersonalRevision else `Personal Provider Config revision conflict: expected ${expected}, current ${current}`. Recommendation is supplied flag ?? (original exact rule.type!==manual-provider-model). Inherited membership fallback above. If rename, reject inherited original then inherited next; error strings as rename. Then original must belong inherited or personal list, else `Model 不存在: ${providerId}/${originalId}`. If rename and next exists reject `Model 已存在: ${providerId}/${nextId}`. If rename, require personal original or `Personal Model 不存在: ${providerId}/${originalId}`, rename members/order+normalize and exact rules atomically. For final config: recommendation true and structurally empty config.toJSON() deletes exact next; otherwise setExact(next, supplied config, recommendation). Structural empty: undefined=true; null/nonobject=false; array=true ONLY if length0 (not recursive); ordinary object all Object.values recursively empty (empty object=true). Thus null fields or nonempty arrays/false/0 remain values. Same providerOrder/defaults; no forced enabled or inherited default injection.

deletePersonalModel: trim ids -> await builtin.read -> transform membership; inherited current rejects `Built-in Model 不能删除: ${providerId}/${modelId}`; require current personal member else `Personal Model 不存在: ${providerId}/${modelId}`. Remove matching IDs, normalize existing requested order using inherited and remaining members, set provider; models.deleteExact; preserve default/order. Dependency map/rules APIs immutable and retain metadata for set operations. No new account policy or validation rules.

Compatibility: exact public facade/interfaces/format/references/errors and operation ordering above, no new APIs/configuration, no source-exposed refactor-only claim, no novelty requirement. Fresh author's own source may be longer than400 lines: retain complete ownership; use private modules only if substantive cohesion justifies them, not threshold slicing. Complete first-ready design/source/inputs/task/access/manifest freeze precedes own review; no compiler/tests/source bodies for author.

Body-free compatibility clarification before first-ready

The exact disposed rejection is a newly created Error("ProviderConfigService 已 dispose") at every disposed check. Native dependency/disposer/listener errors retain their existing identity. This fixes an omission in the original behavioral packet; do not substitute 已释放.

Use only supplied public types plus described group/API domains when needed: ProviderConfig group accepts standard-personal, zai-family, bigmodel-family (or null/undefined). This is fixed dependency policy; do not redefine/modify schemas.

Body-free complete-candidate compatibility corrections

The source-exposed coordinator compared the full frozen revision-02 against the original behavioral obligations and found these observable differences. No inherited code/private names are supplied. Preserve every frozen stage and write a COMPLETE separate corrected revision then separate review.

1. Existing label comparisons and the occupied-label set use providerName ONLY, trimmed and case-insensitive. Missing/null/blank name supplies NO label; never fall back to providerId. Therefore creating a provider named "account" is allowed without a " 2" suffix when an existing providerId="account" has no providerName. Clearing a name also does not introduce its ID as a name or trigger label collision.
2. Saving metadata.providerName that trims to "" stores null, exactly as explicit null does; empty string must not be passed through to a schema. Metadata read/application order in the next rule is templateId, then enabled, then providerName, then final normalized config; supplied fields are tested for undefined and, if supplied, read again to apply. Current rule is obtained and spread before this sequence. Current label is evaluated before next label, each trim before lowercasing. Duplicate-name traversal uses each next effective rule's providerName (no fallback to ID), excluding the current rule id.
3. Three baseline semantics differ. Save-membership normalization and reorder models select the entire exact builtin provider if it exists, otherwise the current template's config; that selected object's missing builtinModelIds falls to [] (never proceeds to template after an existing exact object). add/rename/enable/draft/delete instead fall through FIELD values: explicit membership IDs if present, otherwise exact builtin.builtinModelIds if nonnullish, otherwise current template.config.builtinModelIds, otherwise []. Explicit membership empty array suppresses all baseline IDs in every operation. Sharing one helper must not change either fallback behavior.
4. No inherited-property names are required. Preserve account guards, personal custom group/default/model order, public interfaces/runtime-private surface and all prior failures/access qualifications.

Complete ProviderRegistryService behavior/API contract

Implement entire exported service and interfaces from body-free public declarations. Dependencies retained: ProviderRegistry value from ./registry.js, ProviderConfigResolver from ./resolver.js, types from ./config/index.js, ./sources.js, ./registry.js, ./resolver.js. Never inspect dependency bodies. No account auth/rights/access/key handling is implemented here; accountSource is a fakeable snapshot port. No real I/O/network/native/storage authority, retry timeout/backoff/AbortController/new policy.

Construct stores configSource/accountSource and dependencies.resolver??new ProviderConfigResolver(), allocates a new ProviderRegistry with no arguments immediately as instance initialized state. Constructor does not subscribe/read. The sole lifecycle owner tracks snapshot=null, requested and completed integer generations=0, active refresh Promise=null, started=false,disposed=false, pending reason insertion-order Set, ordered pending waiter list with generation/resolve/reject, source disposer list, change/error listener live Sets. No alternative queue/cache/source manager.

Public API types accompanied. start() is async and asserts not disposed. First sets started=true BEFORE registrations. Evaluate config.onDidChange first, account.onDidChange second, then store both returned disposers together in order. A failed registration leaves started true and no rollback (if second throws first disposer isn't stored). Call/request refresh reason start and await it. Subsequent start with snapshot truthy does not refresh or subscribe again; if no snapshot, request another start refresh and await. A mismatch before first snapshot intentionally leaves earlier start pending, with later matching events able to settle it. start resolves void, no cached first snapshot return.
refresh(reason="explicit") is NONasync: assert not disposed then require started or throw Error("ProviderRegistryService 必须先 start() 再 refresh()"); request refresh and return its new Promise directly. Every request increments requestedGeneration by1, adds raw reason (empty remains empty), appends a new waiter tagged current generation, starts loop if not active/disposed. Requests coalesce only by worker generation; returned Promises are distinct but resolve same published snapshot when covered. No native timer/microtask scheduling other than async Promise operations.

Source callback suppresses when disposed; otherwise requests `${source}:${reason||"changed"}` for config/account and attaches catch swallowing background rejection. Errors remain reported via onDidRefreshError; explicit request rejection still reaches caller. Callbacks run while subscriptions constructed may request before start's own request. Public onDidChange/onDidRefreshError simply add to respective Sets even after disposal and return deletion functions (runtime deletion bool allowed); no disposed check. Read getters/getSnapshot/getView/listProviders/getProvider/getModel/validateSelection remain available after disposal and delegate exactly to snapshot/registry without implicit refresh. Registry validation/config order behavior remains retained dependency policy.

Loop ownership: when no active Promise and not disposed, invoke async worker BEFORE storing its Promise in active slot; attach success finish and rejection handler. Rejection handler rejects waiters through latest requested generation with thrown identity, then finish. Finish only acts if same active Promise, clears slot and if completed<requested starts another loop (ensure suppresses disposed). No explicit rejection normalization/catches added around listeners or disposers.

One worker owns a local ordered reasons Set lasting across stale reads. While completed<requested: capture current requested generation, merge pending reason Set into local reasons then clear pending. In try evaluate config.read() THEN account.read() and Promise.all; if synchronous first read throws, account.read isn't evaluated. Read rejection: if captured generation is now stale, continue (accumulated reasons retained, no events/reject/advance); else commit completed generation, emit refresh error with exact thrown identity and frozen reasons, reject all waiters generation<=captured, return. Native error listener throw skips this rejection step and escapes to outer loop handler, which rejects through latest requested. No retry absent a newer generation.
After successful reads, if stale generation continue before any disposal/mismatch/resolver/registry publication. Else assert not disposed; if disposed this throws Error("ProviderRegistryService 已 dispose") out of worker before publish (waiters already rejected by dispose); no refresh-error event emitted on this path.

Consistency gate BEFORE same revision check: account.basedOnKnorviaBuiltinRevision must equal config.knorviaBuiltinRevision. Mismatch commits completed=captured; if a previous snapshot exists resolve all waiters through captured to the SAME previous snapshot. If none, leave earlier waiters pending. Clear local reasons then continue (a fresh request/event needed; no spin polling). Do not resolve with a mixed config/account pair or use fail-closed fallback/new policy. For a matching pair whose config.revision and account.revision are both same as prior snapshot.sourceRevisions, commit completed, resolve through captured with SAME prior snapshot; no resolver.replace/event and ignore other same-revision field changes. Clear reasons and continue.

For fresh consistent pair in one try: resolver.resolve receives an object with exact own keys/order: knorviaBuiltinProviders,knorviaBuiltinProviderTemplates,personalProviders,knorviaBuiltinModelRules,personalModels,accountProviders=account.providers,accountStates=account.states,personalProviderOrder, preserving exact refs including own undefined. Pass its resolution.registryProviders to registry.replace with [...localReasons].join(","). Then construct shallow frozen snapshot: sourceRevisions shallow frozen {config:config.revision,account:account.revision}; config shallow frozen {...config}, preserving arbitrary enumerable extensions/reference fields; account shallow frozen ONLY revision,basedOnKnorviaBuiltinRevision,providers, plus states iff truthy (undefined/null omitted, truthy retained reference), discarding other extensions; resolution retained by identity; registry=registry.getView(). Store snapshot, commit completed generation, resolve waiter<=generation in list order before emitting changed event; changed event shallow frozen {snapshot,reasons:Object.freeze([...localReasons])}. Visit live change Set synchronously, no defensive copy; listener throws stop next listener, caught in this publication try. Then clear reasons.
Any resolver/registry.replace/snapshot creation/getView/change-listener error: completed=captured, emit error {error exactidentity,reasons frozen copy}, reject waiter<=generation, return. Registry may already be replaced if later failure; snapshot may already stored and waiter already fulfilled if changed listener throws. Never roll back those stages. Error listener throw may escape outer handler; if new request happens during events, subsequent waiter generations remain for next run (unless outer handler latest rejection covers them). No same-revision re-publication repair or masking native errors.

Settling covered waiters must preserve remaining waiter order and list integrity. Covered each resolve/reject in ordered traversal; keep later generation waiters. Native Promise resolver/reject function semantics external; no thenable replacement. reasons are unique insertion order over requests including stale generations; distinct duplicate raw reason collapsed, source empty maps changed but explicit empty remains an entry/join effect. Clear after mismatch/same/published batch; stale read/error retains reasons into next iteration.

dispose() is sync/idempotent. First commit disposed=true; remove all source disposers from list then call in registration order. If any throws, propagates, no waiter rejection/listener clearing reached, later dispose is no-op (legacy limitation). Otherwise create ONE Error("ProviderRegistryService 已 dispose") and reject every pending waiter with SAME error instance, remove them all, then clear both listener Sets. Does not erase snapshot/registry, cancel/read sources, emit error, reset requested/pending/started, detach registry listeners or manipulate account/config ports. In-flight successful reads cannot publish after normal disposal; already rejected waiters keep their original error. Source driven requests after disposal do nothing. Native disposer failures aren't repaired.

Preserve public facade signatures/runtime defaults, exact original error messages/data/identity/event order and snapshot/reference/freeze levels. Native Set mutation iteration (new listener can be seen in same emission, removed listener skipped) remains live. Full first-ready source/design/inputs/task/access/manifest frozen before separate own static review. No novel structure required, no source/body/private helper-name input, no whole-file MIT/cleanroom acceptance. Complete ownership may reasonably use private modules; don't split just for line thresholds.

Body-free public-surface compatibility clarification

Both complete service instances keep state/dependency/private helper members JavaScript-runtime private. Constructed instances have no new public own property keys; class prototypes expose only their declared public methods plus constructor. Use runtime-private # members (or a representation with equivalent observable private surface), not TypeScript-only private ordinary properties/methods, which remain externally enumerable/callable after erasure. No inherited private field/helper names are supplied or required; author chooses its own complete-owner representation.
